liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The transition into Fire on the Mountain is highlighted as a standout moment [7]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): The reviewer specifically enjoys the performance of this track in the upgraded set [8]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): The reviewer appreciates this track being chosen as the second encore [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton.miller.fix.97354.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as having great sound quality and rocking hard; The audience recording is considered as satisfying as a soundboard recording [7][13]
- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton-miller.82238.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1979-02-10.set2.sbd.miller.97352.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 117 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: The performance is characterized as lazily played and terribly sung [17]
- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm.walker-scotton-miller.82239.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 177 min [3]

## Around the show

- The show marks the final appearance of Keith and Donna with the band [13]
- Donna Jean is noted as fully integrated into the band's sound [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton.miller.fix.97354.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM 250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) [1]. Also: Tapes from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker supplied the initial segment; Joe B. Jones assisted with the pitch correction process [1]
- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm250.walker-scotton-miller.82238.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM 250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) [2]. Also: Paul Scotton and Joani Walker provided the cassette tapes for the recording [2]
- **gd1979-02-10.set2.sbd.miller.97352.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) [4]. Also: Rob Eaton lent his DAT for the transfer of the second set; Paul Scotton and Joani Walker provided the patch source material; Joe B. Jones helped with the pitch correction for the recording [4]
- **gd1979-02-10.sonyecm.walker-scotton-miller.82239.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM 250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) [3]
